Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140\+ offices.

  

  

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.  



  

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee\-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be **brilliant.**  



**About the business unit**
  

The Energy unit delivers services to clients globally across several sectors including hydropower, nuclear, waste, renewable generation and transmission \& distribution networks. Together we provide integrated engineering and project management services across the project lifecycle – from concept and design to construction and operations, to decommissioning or repowering and life extension. Together with our clients, we’re helping to deliver the energy transition globally.

  

**Overview of role**


The Energy Unit, specifically the Transmission \& Distribution division are recruiting for Electrical Engineers to join our team. This role is to support client projects from inception and master planning through concept and detailed design stages all the way to commissioning and final completion.


Our work is varied and spans across all forms of Renewable Power Generation, Network Design, Grid Connections, Net Zero Carbon aspirations and Estate Management Planning. We also provide detailed design solutions in the renewables, aviation, data centre, healthcare, nuclear and defence sectors.


Typical projects will include working from a client brief to produce tender specifications, calculations, designs and drawings for new or renovated 11kV and 33kV switchgear networks and renewable energy connections with HV cable connections, transformers, diesel generators, load banks, LV interfaces, SCADA interfaces and protection schemes.

  

Responsibilities:


The successful candidate will provide technical solutions and project leadership in the production of electrical designs for major electrical and multi\-disciplinary infrastructure works. You will be expected to become familiar with the company procedures and provide technical expertise and contributions to bids and proposals in addition to project planning, project delivery and execution to a high standard. You will manage engineering projects and deliverables ensuring they meet the client’s expectations and applicable statutory and regulatory specification, on time and within budget. You will also support and contribute to the development of junior staff and graduates


Typical activities include:


* Ensure project deliverables and scope are clear
* Understand procurement and contract awards such as NEC PSC
* LV and MV network configuration and advice on resilience issues.
* Input into the network configuration and understanding of operations scenarios and impacts.
* LV and MV (up to 33kV) network design.
* LV and MV cable sizing, routing and termination.
* LV and MV substation design layouts.
* LV and MV substation main equipment operations and specifications.
* Understanding and interpretation of client standards and DNO regulations and standards.
* Earthing designs including understanding of design, modelling and calculations for step, touch and transfer potential.
* Protection requirements
* Arc flash requirement
* Review of design submissions within the team against client scope.
  

**Candidate specification:**


Working as part of a Team and reporting to the Project Principal or Principal Engineer, we are ideally looking for candidates who are Chartered, along with:


* Professionally qualified in a relevant engineering discipline
* Proven skills, capabilities and experience in the sector areas mentioned above
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential as the role will require preparation of specifications and reports.
* Co\-ordinate with multi disciplines both internal and external.
* Some experience within electrical project engineering, with focus on installations from LV up to 11kV / 33kV.
* Be competent in the use of MS packages.
* Be aware of and eventually contribute to bid procedures and internal governance.
* Be aware of procurement, construction and commissioning activities.
* Be able to travel in the UK and overseas if required,
* Must have initiative, self\-motivation and the confidence to make decisions.
  

We are actively recruiting a diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities we serve. We recognise that differences in ability, skills and experience are a strength and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

  

**Health and wellbeing**


* Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
* Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
* Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
* A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
* Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.
  

**Financial wellbeing**


* We match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
* Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long\-term illness or injury.
* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.
  

**Lifestyle**

* A minimum of 33\-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and motivated \*\*Full\-Stack Web Developer\*\* to design, develop, test, and maintain modern web applications. The successful candidate will work across both front\-end and back\-end technologies, building responsive user interfaces, developing APIs, managing databases, and ensuring applications are secure, scalable, and reliable.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications.  
\* Build user\-friendly front\-end interfaces using modern web technologies.  
\* Develop and maintain back\-end services, APIs, and server\-side applications.  
\* Design, manage, and optimise databases.  
\* Integrate third\-party APIs and external services.  
\* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-documented code.  
\* Test and debug applications to identify and resolve technical issues.  
\* Implement authentication, authorisation, and web security best practices.  
\* Optimise applications for performance, scalability, and cross\-browser compatibility.  
\* Use Git and version\-control practices for collaborative development.  
\* Deploy and maintain applications in cloud or hosting environments.  
\* Collaborate with designers, developers, product managers, and other stakeholders.  
\* Monitor applications and troubleshoot production issues.  
\* Stay up to date with emerging web development technologies and best practices.

\* Experience with a modern front\-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js  
\* Experience with back\-end technologies such as Node.js, Python, Java, PHP, or .NET.  
\* Good knowledge of REST APIs and web services.  
\* Experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or SQL Server\*\*.  
\* Understanding of Git and GitHub/GitLab.  
\* Knowledge of authentication, security, and API integration.  
\* Experience with responsive and mobile\-friendly web development.  
\* Understanding of software development lifecycle and testing practices.  
\* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.

\* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud\*\*.  
\* Knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.  
\* Experience with automated testing.  
\* Knowledge of microservices or serverless architectures.  
\* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.  
\* Understanding of accessibility and web performance optimisation.

**Personal Attributes**

\* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.  
\* Good communication and teamwork skills.  
\* Ability to work independently and manage priorities.  
\* Attention to detail and commitment to code quality.  
\* Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously improve.

**Education \& Experience**

A degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Web Development, or a related field is desirable. Equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio of web applications may also be considered.

Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Angular/Vue

* UK visa sponsorship

jobs.title: Senior Protection and Control Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Protection and Control Design Engineer**

**Location** – Prenton office with hybrid working pattern. Occasional travel across the SP Manweb licence area and to project, contractor and stakeholder locations as required


**Salary** – from £55,000 \- £68,750


**Permanent \| Full\-time** – 37 hours per week


**Closing date** 8th October 2026  



  

***Help us create a better future, quicker!***

  

Join **SP Manweb** , part of **SP Energy Networks** , as a Senior Protection and Control Design Engineer and play a vital role in powering the UK's transition to Net Zero. This role sits within our SPM 132kV Networks team, where you'll be accountable for developing safe, compliant and cost\-effective protection, control and substation automation solutions across 132kV and associated 33kV networks serving North Wales and the North West of England.  



  

You'll work on high\-value refurbishment, reinforcement, asset replacement and grid access projects that directly enable renewable energy growth. From feasibility through to operational handover, you'll provide authoritative technical guidance on complex, high\-impact design packages whilst promoting safety by design, cyber\-aware engineering and whole\-life asset value.  



  

This is an opportunity to apply your expertise across the full project lifecycle, working with cutting\-edge technology and helping develop the next generation of engineers.  



  

***What you'll be doing***

* Define protection, control and substation automation requirements across feasibility studies, technical specifications and construction strategies
* Prepare and check detailed designs including protection philosophies, single\-line and functional diagrams, AC and DC schematics, interlocking and tripping schemes, wiring diagrams and technical reports
* Undertake and approve protection studies and calculations covering fault levels, protection grading and coordination, current\-transformer and voltage\-transformer requirements, relay burden and saturation, performance characteristics and scheme effectiveness
* Develop and manage protection and control settings, relay schemes and communication\-assisted systems for feeders, transformers, busbars, reactors and customer installations
* Design and deliver IEC 61850\-based substation automation solutions, including system architecture, data models, GOOSE messaging, station and process\-bus interfaces, configuration files and integration with SCADA and telecommunications systems
* Ensure all designs comply with legislation, CDM designer duties, ScottishPower Safety Rules, SP Energy Networks standards and relevant British, European and international standards
* Identify and reduce foreseeable risks through safety by design, recording residual hazards and considering construction, testing, operation, maintenance, resilience, cyber security and environmental impacts
* Develop technical requirements for procurement, assess submissions and supplier proposals, and provide clear recommendations on technical compliance, interoperability, risk and whole\-life value
* Review and check designs, calculations, settings, configurations, drawings and test documentation produced by contractors, consultants, manufacturers and suppliers, ensuring comments and non\-conformances are resolved
* Provide technical assistance during manufacture, factory acceptance testing, site installation, commissioning and energisation, resolving site queries and assessing design modifications
* Maintain effective control of technical actions, assumptions, interfaces, design risks, settings and document status, escalating matters that threaten safety, quality, programme or cost
* Contribute to protection and control strategy, standardisation, lessons learned and technical innovation to help shape future practice

Coach and mentor engineers, designers, graduates and apprentices, delegating work appropriately and providing constructive technical feedback  

* 

  

***What you'll bring***

* Degree, HNC/HND in Electrical Engineering (or related discipline), or equivalent experience.
* Extensive experience in high\-voltage protection and control engineering on UK 132kV and associated 33kV networks.
* Strong technical knowledge of protection schemes, including feeder, transformer, busbar, reactor, switchgear and customer connection protection, alongside control, interlocking and automation systems.
* Experience carrying out and checking protection studies, fault level calculations, grading and coordination assessments, and relay settings using industry\-standard software and manufacturer tools.
* Working knowledge of IEC 61850 substation automation, SCADA integration and protection communications systems.
* Experience producing and reviewing protection philosophies, schematics, specifications, settings reports and testing documentation.
* Understanding of CDM requirements, health and safety legislation, utility standards and design risk management.
* Ability to assess supplier and contractor designs, identify technical risks and provide sound engineering recommendations.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary technical interfaces and clearly communicate engineering decisions to a range of stakeholders.
* Strong project delivery, stakeholder management and mentoring skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and deliver to programme, cost, quality and governance requirements.
* Professional registration (or working towards IEng/CEng) is desirable.
* Some commissioning experience in testing Protection and Control schemes is desirable.
* Full UK driving licence.
  

  

***What's in it for you***

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.  



  

At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action \- our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world \- today and tomorrow.  



  

That's why our benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase \- perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Equity Plans
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers \- save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes \- to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance

Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more  

* 

  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of ScottishPower and of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We have 30,000 substations (1 for every 100 customers), 40,000km overhead lines (that's once around the globe!) and 65,000km underground cables. It’s a role that puts us right at the heart of ScottishPower’s ambition to be Net Zero by 2035\. And we’re taking it very seriously.  



  

With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.  



  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large\-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you’ll fit right in.  



  

We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .


**Mobility**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. If/when required, the Company will support the employee with the necessary Immigration requirements.


**I** **MPORTANT**


Advert will close at 23:59 GMT the day before **Job Posting End Date** below


October\-8\-2026

* Perform maintenance visits and service restorations within SLA targets

* Working at height (ladders, external mounting)
* Electrical safety
* Safe cable routing and fixing
* Ensure all installations meet company and regulatory standards
* Maintain tools, PPE, and company vehicle in safe working order

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Accurately record materials used and time on site
* Provide feedback on recurring issues, installation challenges, or product improvements

**Key Skills \& Experience**

* Understanding of telecoms or ISP field installations (wireless or fixed line)
* Understanding of:
* IP networking fundamentals
* Wireless technologies
* Practical installation skills (drilling, mounting, cabling)
* Customer\-facing experience with good communication skills
* Full UK driving licence

**Desirable**

* Experience with WiMAX / outdoor wireless deployments
* Experience in holiday park or MDUs (multi\-dwelling units)
* Basic understanding of RF troubleshooting tools
* Certifications (e.g. ECS, Working at Height, IPAF – beneficial but not essential)

**Key Behaviours**

* Customer\-first mindset with strong interpersonal skills
* Practical, problem\-solving approach in varied environments
* Ability to work independently and manage workload effectively
* Flexible and responsive to changing schedules and priorities
* High attention to quality and installation standards

### **Company Overview**


Please visit https://www.orbital.net for more information

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**



Renaissance® is a global leader in education technology. We help schools and school groups in the UK and around the world with educational assessments, practice and intervention solutions, and data analytics. Renaissance now incorporates GL Assessment (known internationally as GL Education), too – a leading provider of educational assessments.



Together, our assessments offer the ideal starting point to help teachers understand their students’ strengths and pinpoint areas of need. Our teaching and learning tools then provide effective next steps, with online literacy and maths solutions that meet students exactly where we are.



Worldwide, we support over 18 million students, operating in over 100 countries.


Do you want to help millions of students worldwide reach their potential?



At Renaissance, we build technology that accelerates learning for millions of students globally \- regardless of ability, background, or circumstance. Our assessment platform helps teachers make data\-driven decisions that change lives.



We're a tech\-for\-good company where people come first. We believe great software comes from great teams, and we're looking for Software Engineers who want to combine technical craft with meaningful impact.


**The Role**



You'll work on high\-scale global EdTech systems (Azure, .NET, Angular) that process assessment data for millions of students worldwide, and join a collaborative agile team with autonomy, high engineering standards, and a focus on continuous improvement.


**What makes this different:**


* Craft matters \- We value clean code, a quality mindset, and engineering excellence
* Trust and support \- Teams make technical decisions collaboratively with mentorship when you need it
* Real impact \- Your work helps teachers make better decisions for their students
* Help build our AI\-first future \- We're early in the process of adopting agentic SDLC, you'll help define how we integrate AI into our workflows


 **What You'll Do:**


* Design, build, and maintain features across the full stack (Azure, .NET APIs, Angular frontend, SQL databases)
* Make or contribute to architectural and technical decisions within your domain
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code that solves real problems
* Participate in and improve our engineering practices (code review, testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experiment with AI tools to help build towards our adoption of agentic workflows
* Work closely with product, design, quality assurance, and other engineering teams to deliver valuable outcomes for teachers and students
* Break down ambiguous problems, propose ideas, and help bring them to completion


 **What we'd love to see includes:**


**Technical Experience**


* Some previous professional software development experience
* Full\-stack experience and skills in C\#/.NET, TypeScript/JavaScript, and SQL (you don’t need to be an expert in all three)
* Experience with modern web frameworks (Angular, React, or similar)
* Understanding of system design, REST APIs, databases, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
* Understanding of testing approaches (e.g. unit, integration, end\-to\-end) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines


 **Engineering Mindset**


* You value quality and craft \- testing, clean code, and thoughtful design matter to you
* You're curious about AI tooling (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
* You can work effectively both independently and collaboratively
* You understand trade\-offs \- when to optimize, when to ship, when to refactor
* You care about accessibility, performance, security, and maintainability \- and apply them in practice
* You communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences


 **Nice to Have Experience (But Not Essential)**


* Azure (App Services, Static Web Apps, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL)
* Angular (we'll support you to learn if you're coming from another framework)
* AI\-assisted development tools
* EdTech, SaaS, or mission\-driven tech background
* WCAG accessibility standards


**Additional information:**



This role is based from our office in Houghton le Spring on a hybrid basis \- the team come together a couple of times a week.


**Please note:** We are unable to offer sponsorship for this position, applicants must have full rights to work in the UK and be able to work in our office location.



The closing date for applications will be Thursday 8th October however we will be reviewing applications continually during this time.


**People\-First Culture**


* **Collaborative autonomy** ️ \- Teams make decisions together and have freedom to innovate
* **Engineering excellence** \- We invest in quality, testing, and continuous improvement
* **Growth and learning** \- Access to training, mentorship, and time to experiment with new tools
* **Inclusive and supportive** \- We value diverse perspective, psychological safety, and work\-life balance


**Modern Tech Stack**


* Azure, .NET 8\+, Angular 21, SQL Server
* Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
* Early adoption of agentic SDLC \- help shape how we work
* Continuous modernisation of our stack and practice


**Work/life balance**


* **Hybrid working** (Houghton\-le\-Spring office as a base with pool/ping pong table , dart board , and arcade machine ️)
* **Flexible arrangements** \- We're open to discussing what works for your life (including family responsibilities)
* **Generous leave policies** ️ – 22 days annual leave with the opportunity to purchase more, 3 days company leave over Christmas period , an extra day off during your birthday month , reduced hours (half day Fridays) during Summer and Winter holiday periods conditional on company performance ️❄️
  

We have an ongoing commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and have taken strides to become a more welcoming and inclusive workplace, including the introduction of our DEI Matters Network which is owned and driven by our staff.



We are an equal opportunities employer. We encourage and welcome applications from all underrepresented groups, as we believe and strive for community representation within our organisation.



If you have a disability and would prefer to apply in a different format or would like us to make reasonable adjustments to enable you to apply or attend any interview, please contact us and we will talk this through with you.



All your information will be kept confidential according to GDPR guidelines. Please note that we can only consider applicants who already hold a full work permit.



This role is subject to DBS and background checks.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Waracle are looking for an experienced **Senior .NET Developer** to join our world\-class digital technology consultancy. We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges, creating intelligent digital products and delivering business\-critical IT transformation projects.

  

As a Senior .NET Developer, you will operate at an impactful level to design, build, and deliver robust backend features. We are looking for a pragmatic self\-starter who is skilled at problem\-solving, confident in taking ownership, and capable of figuring things out independently to deliver value quickly.

  

This position is an **Inside IR35** **Contract**, initially for **6 months** and is available on a **Hybrid or Remote** basis from **Dundee, Glasgow, Edinburgh, or London**.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Architectural Delivery:** Design and deliver end\-to\-end backend subsystems and features, ensuring code is modular, maintainable, and built to scale.
* **Problem Solving \& Execution:** Hit the ground running as a self\-starter to analyse, troubleshoot, and solve complex technical challenges independently.
* **Quality \& Security:** Champion high standards through constructive peer code reviews, establishing defensive application security measures, and implementing thorough testing strategies across unit and service levels.
* **Consulting \& Communication:** Translate complex technical choices into clear, accessible language for clients and stakeholders, building strong, trusting relationships.
* **Delivery Accountability:** Balance speed and high\-quality standards thoughtfully to ensure the successful, sustainable delivery of features within required contract timelines.

#### **What You'll Bring**

* Deep, practical experience with **C\#** and both older and current versions of the .NET Framework (including **.NET Framework 4\.8** and modern .NET).
* Solid hands\-on experience working with **Web Forms** as well as **MVC**.
* Strong database skills using **tSQL**, including extensive experience writing and optimising **Stored Procedures** and using lightweight ORMs like **Dapper**.
* Experience handling occasional frontend tasks using **JavaScript**.
* Strong understanding of SOLID principles, maintainability, and industry\-standard security practices.
* Familiarity or experience with modern cloud tools and patterns, such as **Azure**, **Durable Functions**, **Event Sourcing**, **SQL**, and **Docker**.

#### **What to expect from our hiring process**

* **First Hello:** An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, the role, the project and day rate.
* **Craft Showcase:** A focused take\-home task to demonstrate craft expertise, critical thinking and your real\-world expertise.
* **Talking Impact:** A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others and your technical competencies.


Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your **Welcome Ritual** on day one.

*We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.*

Across government, cloud technology underpins the delivery of secure, scalable and modern digital services. As organisations continue to accelerate cloud adoption, strong technical architecture is essential to ensure platforms are resilient, compliant and capable of supporting long\-term transformation. At Ofgem, architecture plays a vital role in enabling the digital services, data capabilities and operational systems that support our mission to protect energy consumers and drive the transition to Net Zero.


Ofgem is on an ambitious transformation journey. Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our technology estate and expanding our use of Microsoft Azure as a strategic platform. This includes delivering secure, scalable and cost\-effective cloud solutions that support digital services, data platforms and organisational change across the business.


As a **Senior Technical Architect (Azure)**, you will lead the design and assurance of Azure\-based solutions across a diverse portfolio of programmes and services. You will provide architectural direction, shape technical strategies and ensure Azure environments are secure, scalable, resilient and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.


Working closely with architects, engineers, delivery teams and senior stakeholders, you will help drive consistency, governance and best practice across Ofgem's cloud landscape, while supporting the successful delivery of critical digital transformation initiatives.


This is a highly influential role requiring deep Azure expertise, strong architectural capability and the ability to balance technical excellence with organisational objectives.

A highly experienced technical architect with a strong track record of designing and delivering Azure solutions within large or complex environments. **Job description**

**Position: Code Sensei**

**Who are we?**

Code Ninjas is the nation’s fastest\-growing kids coding franchise. In our centre, kids learn to code in a fun, non\-intimidating way – by playing and building video games they love. Kids have blast and can’t wait to come back. Parents are thrilled as their children gain confidence and new skills including coding, math, logic, and problem\-solving, as they progress from white to black belt. Our core promise is, Kids have fun, and parents see results.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for Coding Instructors (a 'Code Sensei' as we call them) to join our team of dynamic, energetic, forward thinking minds, working toward our common goal of providing a fun and safe learning environment for children. Our sensei’s are the lifeblood of our Code Ninjas studio and play an integral role in coaching and engaging our young ninjas in our dojos. Yes, you read that right. Here at Code Ninjas we don’t have teachers but ‘sensei’s'; our students are 'ninjas' and our parent\-free learning area is the ‘dojo’.

You will be responsible to instruct \& couch ‘ninja’s’ (Students) as they embark the journey of learning coding, logic and problem\-solving skills in a progressive yet fun.

Are you a University, GCSE or A\-Level student having an interest in computing/coding/programming languages? Code Sensei could be the role for you.

Do you enjoy teaching and building problem solving skills in young engineering minds? Have you mentored youth? Are you experienced in teaching children? This could be the role for you.

In return Code Ninjas Hampstead, Camden will give you a fun and inspiring environment that will enable you to develop and succeed by providing relevant trainings. It will give you a platform to build your carrier by providing Code Ninja led trainings in computer coding \& programming languages whilst you help shape the minds of our future brains.

**Responsibilities include:**

* **Training to be a Sensei** – Training is offered for free to Code Sensei. You will be self\-training on various Code Ninja programs and achieve respective credits ('belts' as we call them) and be up to date with the full curriculum (game based \& computer programming).
* **Instructing as a Sensei** – responsible to instruct, teach \& guide young ‘ninjas’ (students) through the curriculum and help them achieve their belts, milestones and succeed
* Creating a fun, positive and safe environment in which our ninja students can grow.
* Working with our ninja students to help, support and enhance their soft skills such as confidence \& communication.
* Build and run holiday camps from a selection of popular camps in Code Ninja Library \* Participation in Parent and Child tours and taster sessions for prospective families.
* Providing brief feedback to parents after each session on their child’s development in that session.
* Following all opening and closing duties daily.
* Ensuring all health \& safety measures are maintained in the Centre at all times.
* Reporting daily to the Centre Manager with respect to the day’s activities and productivity in the dojo.
* Ability to deliver Virtual Lessons when the need arises.

**Qualifications:**

* Must have a passion for coding and technology
* Must be knowledgeable about coding and technology; or able to quickly pick up basic concepts, knowledge of at least one of the programming languages would be good to have \- JavaScript, Python, C\#, Scratch; and of platforms such as Roblox, Minecraft, etc
* A background in ICT/computer science or similar would be good to have \* Interest in teaching and mentoring.\*
* A working history with children ages 5 and up (mentoring, coaching, tutoring etc.) would be good to have
* Qualification in SEN would be nice to have
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Works well with others; collaborates and must be fun to work with and likes working in fast\-paced environments where requirements can change frequently

**Base Location:** Flexible Scotland \| We're proud to offer a Flexible First approach to work, and this role is no exception. **Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible working options available


**The role**



As a Protection Field Engineer at SSEN Transmission, you'll be instrumental in achieving Net Zero. This hands\-on role is key to expanding and updating our network, directly ensuring the exceptional reliability and resilience of our transmission system for all users.


**You will**


* Ensure the Transmission network operates to the highest reliability standards through technical management of connected protection and control systems.
* Help deliver the multi\-million\-pound capital delivery programme on our transmission network, including the commissioning of new protection assets.
* Support all aspects of field protection work, including commissioning, maintenance, outage management, contractor liaison and budget management.
* At times, you may be required to work away from your base location due to the diverse nature, and sometime remote locations, of our plant and equipment.
* Participate in a paid out of hours standby rota due to the 24/7/365 nature of operating a high voltage Transmission network.


**You have**


* A qualification in a relevant electrical engineering subject (a minimum of HNC level with a recognised apprenticeship or suitable relevant experience being desirable).
* Previous experience and technical knowledge of power systems protection, including installation and commissioning of high voltage plant and apparatus up to 400kV.
* Strong understanding of reading and interpreting protection single line, schematic and block diagrams.
* Experience of carrying out testing and fault\-finding on secondary wiring and auxiliary equipment, including the application of logic and settings files on Protection intelligent electronic devices.
* Existing Senior Authorised Person (SAP) or High Voltage Switching authorisations at Transmission voltages up to 400kV, are highly advantageous for this role or if working towards this.


**A full UK driving license is required as this role will require travelling to our various locations.**

SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. jobs.title: Graduate Control Systems Engineer (SCADA / PLC / RTU)
jobs.description:
**About DCL**

Donavalli Consulting Limited (DCL) is a specialist Operational Technology (OT) and SCADA engineering consultancy based in Reading. We design, upgrade and support the control and telemetry systems that keep water and wastewater services running for millions of people across the South East, working primarily with Water Industry.

Our directly employed team of engineers works on live water industry projects: RTU migration programmes, SCADA platform upgrades, HMI improvements and OT cyber security. We operate management systems aligned to ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 45001 (Health and Safety) and ISO 27001 (Information Security).

Being a small, specialist team means our graduates work alongside Principal and Lead engineers from day one, on real projects, with real responsibility.

**The role**

We are looking for a motivated engineering or computing graduate to join DCL as a Graduate Control Systems Engineer. You will learn to configure, test and commission SCADA, PLC and RTU systems used on water treatment works, sewage treatment works and remote pumping stations.

This is a structured development role. You will start with desk\-based configuration and testing under supervision, then progress to site surveys, commissioning and client\-facing work as your competence grows. The aim is to develop you towards a System Engineer role and, in time, professional registration with a recognised engineering institution.

**Key responsibilities**

* Configure and test SCADA databases, mimics and alarms on platforms such as AVEVA System Platform, InTouch and GeoSCADA (ClearSCADA).
* Support RTU configuration and migration work, including remote outstations and industry\-standard telemetry and communication protocols such as DNP3, WITS DNP3, Modbus, and OPC.
* Assist with PLC and RTU logic changes, including reading and modifying IEC 61131\-3 code (e.g. ISaGRAF, function block diagram, structured text).
* Carry out I/O and signal checks, point\-to\-point testing and data validation against survey and design records.
* Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) and commissioning on operational water and wastewater sites.
* Produce and maintain engineering documentation: test sheets, I/O schedules, functional design inputs, as\-built records and change requests.
* Help develop and use DCL's in\-house Python and C\# tools that automate SCADA validation and data checking.
* Follow OT cyber security practice (IEC 62443 principles) and DCL's ISO 9001, 45001 and 27001 procedures, including safe systems of work on site.
* Work with Water operations and project teams, building good working relationships with clients and site staff.

**What we are looking for**

**Essential**

* A degree in Electrical, Electronic, Control, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Physics or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience such as a completed engineering apprenticeship.
* Basic programming or scripting experience (e.g. Python, C\#, C, or PLC programming from coursework or projects).
* Good understanding of IT fundamentals: Windows, networking (IP addressing, subnets) and Microsoft Office.
* Clear written English, able to produce accurate technical records.
* A methodical approach to testing, with strong attention to detail.
* Willingness to travel to operational sites and work outdoors in all weathers when required.
* The right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

**Desirable**

* A full UK driving licence (or working towards one).
* Exposure to PLC, SCADA or HMI systems through placement, final\-year project or hobby work (e.g. Allen\-Bradley, Schneider).
* Awareness of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP).
* Interest in OT cyber security or the water industry.
* A CSCS card or other site safety training.

**Training, development and benefits**

* DCL Engineer Development Pathway, with gateway assessments.
* Mentoring from Principal and Lead engineers on live projects.
* Practical training in our Reading test environment, using DCL's own Engineering Suite tools.
* Vendor training on AVEVA, GeoSCADA and Schneider Electric platforms.
* Site safety and site access training.
* Clear progression from Graduate to Junior and System Engineer, with quarterly reviews.

**To apply**, send your CV and cover note to **careers@donavalliconsulting.co.uk** with the subject "\<Your Name\> \- Graduate Control Systems Engineer".

Pay: £26,000\.00\-£28,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Reading RG2

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. You'll own the day\-to\-day operations of your team, build and mentor a high\-performing team of analysts, and continuously mature our detection and response capabilities to keep pace with an evolving threat landscape. This is a hands\-on leadership role — you'll support in guiding strategy while staying close enough to work alongside the team and manage incidents.

* Collaborative Leader: You build strong cross\-functional partnerships, championing security across the organization. You foster a collaborative environment where teams work seamlessly to achieve a strong security posture.
* Resilient and Adaptive: You thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively managing complex security projects and leading teams through change. Your ability to adapt and problem\-solve makes you a key asset during challenging situations.

**How You’ll Grow**


* Shape Industry Standards: Participate in leading security conferences, thought leadership initiatives, and industry working groups to shape the future of cybersecurity practices.
* Executive Presence: Gain direct exposure to executive\-level decision\-making, refining your strategic communication and influencing skills.
* Expand Your Leadership Toolkit: Lead a team of skilled security professionals, providing you with ample opportunities to enhance your mentorship, coaching, and talent development abilities.
* Complex Problem\-Solving: Tackle high\-impact security challenges that will push your critical thinking, analysis, and strategy\-building skills.

**Things You’ll Do**


* Lead and manage the Security Operations Center, including 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, and incident response functions
* Hire, coach, and develop a team of CDU analysts and incident responders; build career paths and a strong on\-call/rotation culture
* Senior Lead needs hands\-on credibility. Conduct 1\-on\-1 technical coaching, run mock incident drills, and build skill matrices for junior analysts.
* Own CDU metrics and KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, alert volume/fidelity, coverage) and report on program health to security leadership
* Drive continuous improvement of detection logic, playbooks, and automation in partnership with detection engineering and threat intelligence teams
* Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high\-severity security incidents, coordinating cross\-functional response
* Partner with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IT, Legal, and Product/Engineering teams to close gaps in visibility and response
* Manage relationships with any outsourced/MSSP or co\-managed CDU partners, ensuring SLAs and quality standards are met
* Evaluate and help select CDU tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, ticketing) and drive adoption of automation to reduce analyst toil
* Own CDU\-related audit, compliance, and customer trust requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP as applicable)
* Build and maintain incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post\-incident review processes
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents and provide leadership presence during major security events

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**


* Required:
	+ 7\+ years in security operations, incident response, or a related security discipline, including 4\+ years in a people\-management or team\-lead role
	+ Demonstrated experience running or scaling a 24x7 CDU function, whether in\-house, hybrid, or via MSSP oversight
	+ Strong technical grounding in SIEM/SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR, network and cloud security monitoring, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
	+ Experience leading incident response for significant security events, including coordination with legal, communications, and executive stakeholders
	+ Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining security talent
	+ Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical detail into risk\-based language for non\-technical leaders
	+ Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security operations
* Nice to Have:
	+ Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company handling customer data at scale
	+ Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Qualtrics' customer base (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)
	+ Relevant certifications (CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, or similar)
	+ Experience building or maturing threat detection and threat hunting programs
	+ Background in scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell) to support SOAR workflows

**What You Should Know About This Team**


* Innovation at Our Core: Our Security Operations team embraces change and thrives on solving complex challenges. We value experimentation, continuous learning, and push the boundaries of conventional security practices.
* Collaborative Environment: We believe in the power of teamwork and foster open communication across the team and the wider organization. Your ideas will be heard, and your collaboration will be essential.
* Data\-Driven Approach: We rely on data\-driven insights to inform our security strategies, measure effectiveness, and continuously improve our posture.
* Growth Mindset: We are committed to your professional development. You'll have opportunities to expand your expertise, contribute to high\-visibility projects, and advance your career in cybersecurity.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric/Collibra)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

##### **Responsibilities**


Support the integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric, including evaluating Fabric's capabilities for data provision.


Manage Fabric\-native catalog and discovery functionalities.


Oversee metadata management and business glossary maintenance.


Facilitate data product discovery and data shopping processes.


Handle governance, access management, and data protection policies.


Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives and validate Fabric architecture.


Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.


Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.


Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.


Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.


Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.


Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.


Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.


##### **Skills**


Must have


Python,


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Data Fabric,


Network,


IP Routing,


TCP/IP,


CI/CD


Nice to have


Proven experience of working with MS Data Fabric (DP\-600/DP\-700 certifications),


experience in building AI Landing zones,


experience with FabricIO \& o365 agents,


C\# proficiency, Databricks,


self\-driven/self\-motivated,


PowerShell.


##### **Other**


Languages


English: B2 Upper Intermediate


Seniority


Senior

jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Software Developer Intern who wants to grow at the intersection of software engineering and cybersecurity. You will join an R\&D engineering environment and contribute to the development of enterprise software while working closely with our Application Security team and Security Champions.


This is not a traditional cybersecurity internship focused only on policies, reports, or vulnerability scanning. You will write software, understand real application architectures, and learn how to design, implement, test, and operate software securely.


The goal is to develop a software engineer with strong Application Security expertise who can progressively take on the role of a Security Champion within the development organization.

### **Role description \& Responsibilities**

* Assist team members with feature development and maintenance using .NET and C\#, working with APIs, REST, gRPC and modern service architectures.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests to ensure robust, clean, and reliable code.
* Conduct technical research and spikes to help solve complex platform challenges.
* Actively participate in team agile ceremonies, code reviews, and daily operations, working with Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Contribute to secure code reviews, threat modeling, and the definition of security requirements for new features.
* Support the analysis and triage of vulnerabilities using SAST, SCA, and DAST tooling.
* Get involved in security testing of APIs and services, as well as authentication, authorization, and cryptography topics.
* Explore how Artificial Intelligence can improve Application Security, e.g. AI\-assisted secure code review, vulnerability prioritization, and automation of repetitive AppSec activities.
### **Qualifications**

* Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related studies
* Basic programming experience, preferably C\# / .NET, Java, Python, C\+\+, or a similar language
* Understanding of object\-oriented programming, basic web technologies/APIs, and basic knowledge of databases and SQL.
* Familiarity with Git and a basic understanding of software engineering best practices and unit testing frameworks.
* Familiarity or strong interest in DELMIA Apriso or manufacturing operations software.
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, secure coding principles, authentication/authorization, or common vulnerabilities (e.g. injection, XSS, broken access control) is an advantage, but not required.
* Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Good communication skills in English (written and spoken).

### 

### **What's in it for you**

* Great opportunity to gain hands\-on, practical experience at the intersection of software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI within the IT industry
* Supportive and knowledgeable team, ready to share expertise and best practices
* Wide variety of projects and tasks, ambitious goals and independence in achieving them
* Flexible working hours
* Chillout rooms
* Access to training platform (languages, soft/hard skills)
* Multinational work environment
* And last but not least: Healthy Breakfast once a month, Fruity Tuesdays, Sweets on Thursdays, public transport compensation and MultiLife platform access

-----------------------

Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.  

A trusted partner in operating complex and mission\-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI\-powered, end\-to\-end solutions for all industries. jobs.title: Cloud Developer – Building high-performance DevEx tools in Go/Golang
jobs.description:
The world of cloud is changing. Fast. And we want you, who thrive on the bleeding edge and build cleanly in **Go**, to transform the Cloud space with us!


We’re growing our team with a low\-ego, collaborative, and backend\-focused Cloud Developer who sees **Golang** as their home turf and **Developer Experience (DevEx)** as their main product. You are the force multiplier for client engineering teams: the connective tissue that builds internal tooling, CLI tools, microservices, and paved roads that allow everyone else to ship faster, safer, and with true engineering discipline, especially in an AI\-accelerated dev world.


If you love the simplicity, concurrency, and raw speed of Go, and get a kick out of building tools that other developers actually enjoy using, this is your Playground.


At heart, this is a developer\-productivity role. On assignment, you are the one who elevates a client's entire engineering engine:

* **Go as the core language:** You'll build internal services, custom CLIs, operator tooling, and lightweight backends primarily written in Go. *Of course*, we realize that you probably enjoy other languages as well (could be Java, Python, Typescript, .NET etc.) and this role is not at all limited to Go, it just has to be a proven weapon of choise in your arsenal
* **The Cloud is your substrate:** You bridge code, infrastructure, and delivery pipelines (CI/CD, IaC) so that shipping code to AWS, Azure, or GCP feels effortless for the rest of the team
* **DevEx in the AI Era:** Client teams are shipping faster than ever with AI coding tools. Your job is to build the surrounding guardrails, testing harnesses, and Go\-based tooling that keep that speed safe, reliable, and clean


You’re less about churning out standard end\-user business logic, and more about eliminating friction, reducing toil, and building the high\-speed infrastructure that other devs rely on daily.

### **What this role is (and is not)**

**What this role is:**

* **Primary Go/Golang Development:** Designing and building fast, concurrent, and reliable internal services, CLI tools, libraries, and developer platforms
* **Smoothing the path to production:** Developing CI/CD, build pipelines, and paved roads that make shipping code fast, safe, and repeatable
* **Elevating team velocity:** Doing the architectural and connective work that acts as a force multiplier for whole engineering orgs
* **Bringing discipline to AI workflow:** Creating the harnesses, guardrails, and integrations that let teams leverage AI without introducing chaos

**What this role is not:**

* **Not a "vanilla" feature dev:** You won't be stuck in standard CRUD/backlog feature loops. Your product is the developer platform itself
* **Not a frontend or pure Data/ML role:** You consume and integrate AI services and cloud primitives
* You don't train ML models or build data pipelines as your core craft

### **Who are you?**


Your temperament matters as much as your code. You’re a curious, low\-ego builder who takes pride in system craftsmanship, writes clean and maintainable Go code, and communicates clearly.

**Skills \& Background:**

* **Go (Golang) is your primary language and home turf:** You know its concurrency patterns, standard library, and ecosystem inside out.
* **5\+ years** in software engineering / backend / cloud engineering, with a genuine passion for *building for builders*
* Comfort or depth in at least one secondary modern language (e.g., Python, C\#, Java, or TypeScript)
* **Cloud \& IaC experience:** Solid foundation in AWS, Azure, or GCP, combined with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform preferred)
* **Demonstrable engagement with AI tooling:** Whether it’s building CLI wrappers around LLMs, using AI coding assistants in your workflow, or integrating AI SDKs into Go apps
* **Fluency in Swedish and English** (as client engagements are primarily conducted in Swedish)


Bonus: Kubernetes experience (managed or self\-managed).


Note: no ss\-hats wanted or needed.

### **Let's Play!**


Applying to us is a breeze!

* Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
* Answer the choice\-questions (no "please\-rewrite\-your\-resume" nonsense, promise)
* Feel free to include links to your portfolio, GitHub or similar if you have stuff you're proud of that you want to share with us

**Important notes:**

* Playground Group does *not*provide visa sponsorship or relocation support
* Applicants must already have a permanent *and* independent right to work in Sweden
* As part of the final stage of the recruitment process, a background check conducted by a third party will be carried out.

### **Welcome to Playground!**


At Playground, you work on real, complex assignments for well\-established and ambitious clients, not bench projects or short\-lived experiments. Our teams are trusted with production systems, platforms, and data that actually matter. Here growth comes from ownership, curiosity, and doing the work properly. You’re trusted to think, contribute, and keep getting better, one meaningful step at a time.


Playground brings together specialized domains under one umbrella, with a shared culture and way of working, and easy access to broad technical expertise when it helps move the work forward.


Buzz: Cloud Engineer, SW Developer, Fullstack Developer, Software Architect, Coder, Hacker, Utvecklare, AI, AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloud Consultant
