jobs.title: Senior Data Architect, Scientific Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Agilent instruments produce the measurements behind pharmaceutical quality control, food and environmental testing, and research labs worldwide. That data sits in dozens of software products, and we are building a platform that lets our products, our customers' workflows, and AI agents find and use it wherever it lives.

  

We are hiring a data architect to own the discovery and access side of that platform: how scientific data is registered and found, and how it is composed and served. The platform architecture is established; the target state for discovery and access, and the path to it, are yours to define.

  

You work under the Lead Data Architect, who owns cross\-service standards and governance. Within your areas, the architecture decisions are yours; cross\-service decisions go to the Lead with evidence, options, and a recommendation.

  

This is an architecture role with hands\-on evidence: you decide the architecture for your areas, stay with engineering through implementation, and read the code, run the queries, and build the proof of concept when an argument needs one.

 **Your areas:**

* Data access. Your part of the federated GraphQL gateway, which the platform team owns how connected systems are represented on it, directly or through data services; the read layer that composes results across systems; and the application data services that expose access\-controlled views of scientific data to products, workflows, and AI consumers.
* Catalog and search. The catalog record model, how connected systems register their data and how that metadata is represented, search over it, and the path to richer indexes like vector and graph.

  

Access is the first\-year priority; catalog work runs alongside as the first connectors land. File management, metadata extraction, and semantic standards are owned by other architects on the team. The data is scientific data created by software products: results, methods, samples, files. ERP, CRM, and other enterprise business systems are out of scope.

 **What you will do:**

* Establish how the catalog and access paths behave today and define the target state: service boundaries, contracts, integration patterns, and the path between the two.
* Own the schemas and contracts your areas depend on: catalog records, subgraph boundaries, data service views, and versioned event schemas. Design them and make explicit which system is authoritative for each piece of information under the program's data governance rules, and version them so existing consumers keep working.
* Design the access paths AI agents use to read what they can, under what controls, and with what provenance.
* Review proposed integrations against your contracts and the program's participation requirements. Change your contracts when the evidence warrants and propose changes to the requirements.
* Design modernization paths for legacy sources that keep customers running through the transition, including moves from on\-premises to hybrid or cloud.
* Set query and index performance targets for catalog and access paths.
* Design the pipelines that keep the catalog, the search index, and the access views current as data arrives, from extractor output through backfill and recovery.
* Work directly with engineering: clarify designs, evaluate implementation plans, review delivered work against the decisions.
* Write the decision records and diagrams for your areas, and explain the tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.

 **What we work with:**

* .NET (C\#) services, Angular front ends, and a federated GraphQL gateway
* PostgreSQL by default, with Oracle and SQL Server across the installed base
* RabbitMQ for messaging and event\-driven change discovery
* Kubernetes and Helm alongside Windows installers for on\-premises and hybrid customers, with S3\-compatible object storage
* Scientific data in proprietary instrument formats as well as vendor\-neutral formats like Allotrope
* AI assistants in daily use

**Qualifications**
------------------

 **Required qualifications:**

* Has 8\+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture with distributed systems: service boundaries, APIs, and event\-driven integration.
* Has defined architecture ahead of finalized standards and governance and can show which decisions held up and which had to change.
* Has owned the architecture of a production system in at least one of these areas: data catalogs and metadata management (DataHub, OpenMetadata, or similar); search and indexing (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar); API or federated\-query data access layers (Apollo Federation, or similar); or the data layer of a scientific, laboratory, or regulated application.
* Writes SQL and reads execution plans in PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
* Has built and run data pipelines, including recovery and backfill.
* Reads production code in a typed language (C\#, Java, TypeScript, or similar) and can build a proof of concept.
* Uses AI tools in daily architecture and data work (profiling and cleaning data, reading and generating code, drafting decision records) and can show the process: what you delegate, what you verify, and how.
* Works across product, engineering, and business teams without direct authority.

 **Preferred qualifications:**

* Has delivered data products consumed by applications: APIs, views, or datasets that other software depends on.
* Working knowledge of catalog, search, and data access beyond the area you have owned.
* Laboratory informatics or regulated life sciences, including data integrity and audit trail expectations.
* Architecture decision records, C4 or similar diagrams, and interface contracts.
* Cloud integration patterns (identity, storage, messaging, managed data services) alongside on\-premises deployment.

 **Additional Details**


This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. new_jobs.title: Junior Frontend developer
new_jobs.description:
**Front\-end Developer**
------------------------


Zie jij de wereld in grids, componenten en pixels die nét niet goed uitgelijnd staan? Dan willen we je spreken.


Bij Twize zoeken we een **junior / medior UX / Front\-end Developer** die enthousiast wordt van goed gebouwde websites en webapplicaties.


Je hebt al ervaring met HTML, CSS en JavaScript en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen in moderne front\-end development. Of je die ervaring hebt opgedaan bij een bureau, tijdens stages, met eigen projecten of bij een vorige werkgever vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je kunt en hoe snel je leert.


Je werkt aan maatwerk websites, webshops en webapplicaties voor uiteenlopende klanten. Daarbij bouw je niet alleen wat er in Figma staat, maar denk je mee over UX, componenten, performance, toegankelijkheid en hoe we ons developmentproces slimmer kunnen maken.


We verwachten niet dat je alles al weet. Wel dat je nieuwsgierig bent, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en nieuwe technieken graag uitprobeert.


En AI? Daar zijn we niet bang voor. We gebruiken het dagelijks om sneller en slimmer te ontwikkelen. We zoeken iemand die daarin mee wil groeien en graag ontdekt hoe AI ons vak verandert.


Afhankelijk van je ervaring stap je bij ons in als junior of medior en krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen projecten.

**Front\-end first, met interesse in de rest**
----------------------------------------------


Je focus ligt op front\-end development, maar bij Twize kijk je verder dan alleen je eigen stukje code.


Je werkt onder andere met:

* HTML, JavaScript en (S)CSS
* Component\-based development
* Git, npm en moderne build tooling
* WordPress, WooCommerce, Nextjs frontends en Laravel applicaties.
* PHP aan de back\-end
* Docker voor onze lokale developmentomgeving
* Figma en design systems
* AI\-tools en Design\-to\-Code workflows


Je hoeft bij binnenkomst zeker niet overal expert in te zijn. We vinden het belangrijker dat je de basis goed begrijpt en zin hebt om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

**Meer dan alleen code**
------------------------


Bij Twize zit je niet verstopt achter een ticketsysteem.


Je hebt contact met klanten, denkt mee over oplossingen en bent betrokken bij het hele project: van ontwerp en techniek tot livegang en doorontwikkeling.


Als junior doe je dit samen met een ervaren collega. Naarmate je groeit, krijg je steeds meer eigen klanten en projecten onder je hoede.


Als medior verwachten we dat je een project steeds zelfstandiger kunt oppakken, technische keuzes kunt onderbouwen en rechtstreeks met klanten kunt schakelen.


Eigenaarschap vinden we belangrijk. Zie je iets dat beter kan? Dan hoef je niet te wachten tot iemand je vertelt dat je het moet verbeteren.

**Part of the team**
--------------------


We zijn een klein team en werken veel met elkaar samen.


Dat betekent dat je makkelijk communiceert, elkaar helpt als dat nodig is en het leuk vindt om kennis te delen. Heb je een nieuwe library ontdekt, een handige AI\-workflow gebouwd of een slimmere manier gevonden om iets te ontwikkelen? Laat het vooral zien.


Maar werk is bij ons niet alleen code.


We lunchen samen, borrelen regelmatig en organiseren ieder jaar een flinke trip. De ene keer zitten we op Ibiza, de andere keer staan we ergens in de sneeuw.


En ja, er loopt ook een kantoorhond rond.

**Over Twize**
--------------


Twize is in 2018 opgericht door Joep en Laurens en zit sinds 2020 in het centrum van Breda.


We zijn een compact digital agency dat maatwerk digitale producten ontwikkelt voor inmiddels meer dan 80 klanten.


Onze focus ligt op:

* Maatwerk websites
* E\-commerce
* Webapplicaties
* Service \& doorontwikkeling


We werken niet met lagen managers. Iedereen heeft zijn eigen specialisme, maar werkt samen aan hetzelfde resultaat.


Een aantal dingen vinden we daarbij belangrijk.

**Maatwerk**  

We bouwen geen dertien\-in\-een\-dozijn websites. Onze oplossingen worden afgestemd op de klant.

**Partnerschap**  

We willen geen leverancier zijn die na livegang verdwijnt. We groeien mee met onze klanten en werken vaak jarenlang samen.

**Eigenaarschap**  

Iedereen is binnen Twize ergens Product Owner van. Dat kan een klantproject zijn, onze component library of desnoods de koffiemachine.

**Vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid**  

We kijken liever naar de waarde die je toevoegt dan naar waar je laptop precies staat. Soms werk je op kantoor in Breda, soms thuis en soms ergens waar de zon wat vaker schijnt.

**Wat wij jou bieden**
----------------------


Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring kom je bij ons binnen in een junior of medior rol.


Je verdient **€2\.600 – €4\.100 bruto per maand** op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.


Daarnaast krijg je:

* Een jaarlijkse omzetbonus én persoonlijke bonus
* Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur
* Een MacBook Pro met alles wat je nodig hebt
* Flexibiliteit om thuis of op afstand te werken
* Een elektrische fiets
* Een sportvergoeding
* Veel vrijheid om jezelf technisch te ontwikkelen
* Direct invloed op hoe we binnen Twize front\-end development aanpakken


Geen leaseauto dus. Maar met een elektrische fiets ben je in Breda waarschijnlijk alsnog eerder op kantoor dan je buurman met zijn leasebak.

**Wat je gaat doen**
--------------------


Je werkt onder andere aan:

* Nieuwe websites, webshops en webapplicaties ontwikkelen
* Websites van onze 80\+ klanten doorontwikkelen
* Figma\-designs vertalen naar sterke, herbruikbare front\-end componenten
* Meedenken over UX en interactie
* Codekwaliteit en performance verbeteren
* Toegankelijkheid meenemen in je developmentwerk
* Onze component library verder uitbouwen
* Nieuwe front\-end technieken en tooling onderzoeken
* AI\-tools inzetten binnen je dagelijkse developmentproces
* Meedenken over technische keuzes en architectuur
* Werken aan WordPress\-, WooCommerce\- en volledig maatwerkprojecten


Als medior krijg je daarnaast steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid voor projecten, klanten en technische keuzes.

**Dit breng je mee**
--------------------


We zoeken vooral iemand met een goede basis en de drive om beter te worden.


Je hebt:

* Ervaring met HTML, CSS/SCSS en JavaScript
* Ervaring met responsive development
* Gevoel voor UX en detail
* Ervaring met Git
* Interesse in component\-based development
* Oog voor performance en toegankelijkheid
* Interesse in AI en moderne developmenttools
* Het vermogen om zelfstandig problemen uit te zoeken
* Goede communicatieve vaardigheden
* Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal


Professionele ervaring is mooi meegenomen. Denk aan ongeveer **1 tot 3 jaar**, maar een sterk portfolio, goede stages of overtuigende eigen projecten tellen wat ons betreft net zo goed mee.

### **Extra punten voor**


Ervaring met WordPress, WooCommerce, Medusa, PHP, TypeScript, Docker of design systems is mooi meegenomen.


Maar nogmaals: je hoeft niet overal vinkjes te kunnen zetten.


Als jij een sterke front\-end basis hebt, nieuwsgierig bent en bij het lezen van deze vacature denkt *hier kan ik echt veel leren én toevoegen*, dan horen we graag van je.

new_jobs.title: Vacature: Process Mining Engineer - NN Bank Hypotheken - View vacancy
new_jobs.description:
NN Bank Hypotheken is op een missie om de digitale retailbank van Nederland te worden. Daarbij is het (digitaal) optimaliseren van processen van een hypotheek op basis van data een essentieel onderdeel! Door onze digitale diensten en processen naar een hoger niveau te brengen, maken we het verschil voor onze klanten en onafhankelijke adviseurs. Dat data gedreven werken waarbij we gebruikmaken van process mining tooling is daarbij onze sleutel tot succes.


En jouw rol is daarbij van groot belang! Jij bent degene die ons team naar een hoger niveau brengt in data gedreven werken en het gebruik van process mining en daarmee optimale waarde levert in het optimaliseren van onze processen voor onze klanten, adviseurs en collega’s. Zo zorg je er samen met je team voor dat onze dienstverlening sneller, betrouwbaarder en voorspelbaarder wordt.


We staan aan het begin van een hele mooie en interessante reis en zijn op zoek naar mensen zoals jij die helpen deze verandering te realiseren.


Als NN Bank helpen we mensen zorgen voor wat zij echt belangrijk vinden. Zoals het realiseren van hun woonwensen voor nu en later. Daarvoor werken we aan een klantgerichte, digitale en data gedreven bank. Waarbij we met behulp van technologie het verschil gaan maken.


Onze missie is om onze klanten, intermediairs en medewerkers een optimale ervaring te geven in het hypotheek proces van aanvraag tot aflossing, zodat klanten hun woonwens kunnen realiseren. Belangrijk daarbij is dat je als Process Mining Engineer, ervoor zorgt dat we onze process mining tools optimaal inzetten voor analyses en inzichten zodat verbeteringen en optimalisaties in de hypotheken processen gerealiseerd worden.


Je staat te popelen om nieuwe dingen te leren en je deelt je kennis over data gedreven werken en process mining enthousiast met je collega's. Je bent nieuwsgierig, neemt eigenaarschap en je waardeert feedback, voor jezelf en anderen, omdat je begrijpt dat feedback ons allemaal helpt groeien.


**Wat je gaat doen**

Je bent een enthousiaste en ervaren ontwikkelaar op het gebied van process mining. Als Process Mining Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, implementeren en onderhouden van proces mining inzichten in onze process mining tool Celonis. Je werkt aan het realiseren van dashboards en het analyseren van gegevens om inzichten te verkrijgen en de efficiëntie van bedrijfsprocessen te verbeteren.


Verantwoordelijkheden:


* Integreren van ontvangen data in het data model van onze process mining tool en het onderhouden van dat data model
* Zorgdragen voor en aantonen dat we werken volgens en voldoen aan de IT risico beheersings maatregelen
* Ontwikkelen en implementeren van process mining inzichten binnen de hypotheken keten
* Creëren van dashboards en visualisaties met behulp van onze process mining tool, Celonis, om procesinformatie effectief te ontsluiten naar de collega’s in de teams en naar de business
* Bijdragen aan de continue verbetering van de process mining methodologieën en \-technieken binnen het team
* Samenwerken met collega’s binnen en buiten je team, zoals data engineers, data\-analisten en business analisten, om de beste proces oplossingen te ontwerpen en te implementeren
* Ondersteunen van gebruikers bij het begrijpen en gebruiken van de ontwikkelde process mining inzichten

**Wat wij jou bieden**


NN investeert in een inclusieve, inspirerende werkomgeving en in vaardigheden en competenties voor de toekomst. Daarbij passen arbeidsvoorwaarden die aansluiten bij wat er vandaag nodig is én die rekening houden met de toekomst. Zo bieden we onze medewerkers de mogelijkheid het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij bieden jou:


* Salaris tussen € 4\.527 en € 6\.036 op basis van 36 uur en afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
* 13de maand en vakantiegeld wordt maandelijks uitbetaald bij je salaris
* 27 vakantiedagen bij een werkweek van 5 dagen en drie Diversiteitsdagen
* Een moderne pensioenregeling uitgevoerd door BeFrank
* Volop training\- en opleidingsmogelijkheden
* NS Business Card 2e klas, waarmee je onbeperkt kunt reizen, ook privé. Reis je liever met eigen vervoer? Declareer dan je kilometers
* Thuiswerkvergoedingen voor internet en een goede werkplek

**Wat je meebrengt**


Als Process Mining Engineer heb je passie voor data en het gebruik van data voor het analyseren van (digitale) werkstromen en het vertalen van business wensen en proces optimalisaties naar concrete requirements. Daarbij heb je gedegen ervaring met process mining tooling, het integreren van organisatie databronnen met Celonis en heb je ervaring en drive om processen te optimaliseren en digitaliseren. Optimalisaties en verbeteringen in het proces onderbouw je met concrete getallen en bedragen. Samenwerken is voor jou een vanzelfsprekendheid, waarbij je goed en duidelijk communiceert en verbinding weet te maken met je directe collega’s, gebruikers en andere stakeholders. Daarbij ben je betrokken, heb je een goede dosis daadkracht en neem je eigenaarschap. Verder beschik je over:


* Een afgeronde HBO of Universitaire opleiding
* Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring, waarvan tenminste 2 jaar in een vergelijkbare functie
* Ervaring met process mining tooling en technieken (bij voorkeur Celonis) om daarmee optimalisaties in processen te herkennen en te analyseren en deze te vertalen naar concrete en aantoonbare verbeteringen
* Inzicht in bedrijfsprocessen en het vermogen om complexe gedigitaliseerde processen aan de hand van data en datastromen te analyseren en te begrijpen. Bij voorkeur in het hypotheek proces
* Kennis en ervaring in het werken in een Agile omgeving waar samenwerking en continu verbeteren de basis vormen

**Met wie je werkt**


Je gaat deel uitmaken van een multidisciplinair team met Customer Journey specialisten (product\- en procesmanagers). Het team heeft als missie het optimaliseren van de hypotheek processen bij Nationale\-Nederlanden. Jij en je teamleden nemen verantwoordelijkheid voor de teamresultaten en zijn niet bang om fouten te maken, te delen en ervan te leren. We zijn trots op wat we bereiken, vormen een hecht team en vieren onze successen. Samenwerken is de basis van deze successen.


**Heb je vragen?**


Voor vragen over de procedure kun je terecht bij Bianca Schaareman, Talent Acquisition Specialist via bianca.schaareman@nn\-group.com.


Twijfel jij of je wel 100% aan de criteria voldoet? Dan willen we je aanmoedigen om toch te solliciteren. Wij zijn benieuwd naar jouw unieke kwaliteiten!  

  



Stel je vraag aan Bianca Schaareman
**Bij** **NN** **geloven we dat onze verschillen ons sterker maken.**


We verwelkomen talent in alle vormen en waarderen de unieke ervaringen, achtergronden, perspectieven en kwaliteiten die iedereen meebrengt. Daarom bouwen we aan een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom, gewaardeerd en vrij voelt om zichzelf te zijn.


Twijfel je of je aan alle functie\-eisen voldoet? Laat dat je niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We zijn niet alleen geïnteresseerd in je ervaring, maar ook in je motivatie, je potentieel en de impact die je wilt maken.


**Be yourself. You belong at NN.**


**Ben je net zo enthousiast?**
------------------------------


Je wordt doorgestuurd naar NN's recruitment systeem, Workday, waar je kunt solliciteren en jouw sollicitatie kunt beheren.



**Kan ik je ergens mee helpen?**
--------------------------------


### **Bianca Schaareman**


Recruiter


Send email to Bianca Schaareman


**Wat gebeurt er na je sollicitatie?**
--------------------------------------


**1** **Je solliciteert**
-------------------------


Jouw CV en motivatie worden door de Talent Acquisition Specialist en manager bekeken. Je ontvangt een reactie binnen twee weken.


**2** **Interview(s) en online assessment**
-------------------------------------------


We streven ernaar binnen een week het eerste gesprek in te plannen. Voorafgaand aan je tweede gesprek vragen we je een online assessment te maken.


**3** **Aanbod**

**4** **Welkom bij NN**
-----------------------


Aanbieding geaccepteerd? Gefeliciteerd! Om alles ook administratief goed te regelen starten we de pre\-employment screening en sturen we jouw arbeidsovereenkomst toe.

* Berlin (DE)

**What do we do?**
------------------


**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**


Thinkproject is a European leader in the digitalization of the construction industry, with
  

offices and customers spanning Europe and beyond.


Founded in 2000 — when construction project planning was still predominantly manual — Thinkproject was built on deep industry expertise and a mission to make complex
  

construction projects manageable. Today, we call it Construction Intelligence: software
  

that makes construction projects more efficient, safer, more punctual, and above
  

all, more sustainable.


**VDC Manager** is one of the flagship products in our portfolio — a complete openBIM
  

platform at the intersection of 3D modeling, process management, and data
  

intelligence.


**What your day will look like**
--------------------------------


**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a C\+\+ Software Developer to join the team behind VDC
  

Manager — Thinkproject's complete openBIM software, developed by industry experts
  

and trusted by AEC professionals worldwide.


VDC Manager enables the merging of diverse data and information into BIM processes,
  

including model checking and clash detection in 3D models, construction schedule
  

creation and 4D simulation, quantity and dimension determination for cost calculations, and much more. As a member of the engineering team, you will take ownership of complex features, drive technical decisions, and help shape the future of one of Europe's leading BIM platforms.


**What You Will Do**
  

**Core Development**


* Architect, design, develop, and test new and existing features within VDC Manager
* Write clean, well\-structured, secure, and testable modern C\+\+ code (C\+\+17/20\)
* Take ownership of complex technical areas — from geometry processing and 3D rendering to data exchange and cloud connectivity
* Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability
* Drive technical analysis and research, including evaluation and selection of technical approaches and third\-party components

**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, UX designers, and BIM domain experts to translate requirements into robust technical solutions
* Demonstrate and present technical work to product owners and stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
* Work as part of a distributed, international team — contributing to technical discussions on implementation approaches and user interfaces
* Continuously learn and apply modern tools, frameworks, and engineering processes
**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------


**Must\-Have**


* Knowledge of C/C\+\+, including modern standards (C\+\+14/17/20\).
* Hands\-on experience with graphics programming (OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, or similar)
* Strong skills in software architecture, data structures, and design patterns
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills — able to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, software quality practices (performance, scalability, security, testability)
* Fluency in English (written and spoken) — our working language across the engineering team

**Strong Advantages**


* 2\-3 years of professional software development experience.
* Experience with Qt for desktop application development
* Knowledge of BIM concepts, workflows, and data formats (IFC, BCF) and/or experience in the AEC industry
* Experience with JavaScript (user scripts), Python (utilities and build tooling), or C\# (plug\-in development and web services for Thinkproject cloud connectivity)
* Familiarity with web services and REST APIs for cloud platform integration
* German language skills are a plus but not required

**Code Sample (Required)**
  

As part of your application, please share a C/C\+\+ code sample that best represents your coding style and preferences.


* It does not need to be executable or a complete program
* It can come from a personal project or a previous role (anonymization is perfectly fine)
* You are welcome to supplement it with screenshots, videos, papers, or prototypes — anything that helps showcase your work and engineering thinking
* This is not a test — it is an opportunity to show us how you think and how you write code.
**What we offer**
-----------------


**Hybrid working \| Work from abroad \| Flexible working hours \| Language courses \| Great learning opportunities \| Headspace access \| Women's Network \| Corporate volunteering \| Social events**
  

  

Employee satisfaction is our top priority. Our people make Thinkproject what it is today.
  

We value a work environment where everyone can help shape our culture through open
  

feedback and mutual respect. We believe that flexibility and a diverse benefits program
  

are key success factors — for our employees and for our business.
*We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all*
  

*backgrounds, nationalities, and career paths.*
**Your contact:**
-----------------


Preethika Ramdass


Please submit your application, including salary expectations and potential date of entry

  

  

Working at thinkproject.com \- **think career. think ahead.**

new_jobs.title: Data Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

AECOM is seeking an experienced **Data Engineer** to play a key role in designing, delivering, and optimising data platforms and solutions across a wide range of projects.


As a **Data Engineer**, you will be responsible for delivering components of the data solution lifecycle, ensure solutions adhere to standard quality metrics (scalability, secure, resilient etc) and design data\-driven data architecture that serves value and delivers insight. Your work will directly support AECOM’s mission to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions to our clients.


You will work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and cross\-functional digital teams, supporting analytics use cases and occasionally contributing to light data\-science activities such as feature engineering, exploratory analysis, or model operationalisation.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Develop concepts through the solution lifecycle, ensuring scalability and optimisation whilst considering cost.
* Oversee end\-to\-end data processes such as ingestion, transformation, modelling, and integration across multiple external, facing projects.
* Demonstrate that solutions have met client performance, quality, security, and governance expectations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional data teams to gather client requirements.

**Quality, Governance \& Operational Excellence**

* Work closely with Data Analysts and Data Scientists to support analytical projects providing support for work such as feature engineering, and big data\-analysis activities.
* Collaborate with project managers, architects, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration of data solutions within wider digital ecosystems.
* Uphold data engineering best practices including code quality, testing, CI/CD, and documentation standards.
* Adhere to project data governance controls, including metadata management, access controls, data lineage, PII protection, and compliance with organisational and regulatory requirements.
* Develop monitoring and alerting strategies for data solutions, maintaining high availability, performance, and reliability.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across infrastructure, data solutions, and custom analytical products.

**Innovation, Prototyping \& Continuous Improvement**

* Continuously explore new cloud capabilities, data platforms, and modern data stack tools to drive innovation within the team.
* Foster a culture of knowledge\-sharing, standardisation, and collaborative team practices.

  

**Qualifications** *Here’s what we’re looking for:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* Advanced proficiency in at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (Python preferred; Scala, Java, or C\# also beneficial).
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of relational databases, non\-relational stores, and data warehouse principles.
* Solid experience with data modelling methodologies (dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, data vault, etc.).
* Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT pipelines and modern workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions).
* Professional experience in delivering cloud\-based data engineering solutions at scale, with strong client\-facing, stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills..

**Security Clearance**


Please note that our offer of employment is conditional upon your ability to meet UK security clearance requirements. This is necessary for you to work on the full range of projects requiring security clearance at AECOM Infrastructure and Environment UK Limited.


We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at ReasonableAccommodations@aecom.com. At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.


If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!

 **Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public\- and private\-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

**Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity**


You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.


You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.


AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well\-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.


Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry\-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.


We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long\-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

new_jobs.title: Graduate Sustainability Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Join Our Team:
**PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**  

Cundall’s leading Sustainability \& Building Physics team is a key part of our international business. As a recognised leader in sustainability across the world, our team believes that we have so much more we can and need to do. With a brilliant track record of designing innovative, sustainable and energy efficient solutions, that minimise the use of natural resources, the team are looking for graduates who are passionate about helping us make a positive impact to our environment and a difference to our homes, offices, industry and community.  

Join our Sustainability Team and you can be involved in innovative and award\-winning projects – past projects have included the prized Hong Kong Science Park, Australia’s first 6 star Green Star community, and the largest bio\-medical precinct in the Southern Hemisphere.
The Role You'll Play:

This is an excellent opportunity for talented sustainability graduates to join our teams to work on some of the most exciting sustainable design projects in UK and around the world.

  

Working under the guidance and supervision of the experienced team, you’ll develop your existing knowledge and skills in energy modelling and assist with the development of energy and sustainability strategies for new build and existing buildings. You will find yourself working on projects that fall within the following workstreams:

* Building physics and parametric model services
* Building performance and operational energy optimisation
* Certification and compliance
* Health and wellbeing advice and guidance
* Net zero and whole life carbon services
* Sustainability design and ESG services


With the opportunity to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop over time, you’ll be supported and encouraged to work towards Chartership through one of our accredited training schemes.


The Skills You'll Bring:
* On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
* Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level in Sustainable Engineering or the Built Environment (or equivalent).
* You have demonstrable knowledge and experience of building physics, particularly in relation to heat transfer, energy, thermal comfort and natural ventilation.
* A working knowledge of climate\-based daylighting analysis, operational energy calculation using TM54, sustainability rating tools such as BREEAM and life cycle carbon costing would also be really beneficial.
* Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB).
* You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
* Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can\-do attitude.

**What’s in it for you?**

  

We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.  

  

Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

* A one\-off joining bonus of £1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
* A £2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
* 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
* A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.


Graduate Brochure
Job Description *Must have right to work in the UK, we do not provide sponsorship for this role.* **We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

Our Critical Systems teams at Cundall play a key role in making buildings more energy efficient, cost effective to run and, ultimately, more sustainable. To do this, we’re looking for graduates who have a desire and enthusiasm to make a difference: in our homes, offices, projects, industry and community.  

Working across a variety of sectors, our building services engineers are a source of world leading expertise, producing innovative and award\-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project.

**PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**  

With 29 locations, Cundall’s global presence allows our structural engineers to be involved in many challenging and exciting building projects.

  

Working across a variety of industry sectors, our Structures teams are renowned for producing innovative and award\-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. To build on our great work so far, we are looking for graduates who want to create, improve and protect the environment in which we live and provide the facilities for day\-to\-day life, transport and industry to function effectively.  

The Structural engineering teams provide industry\-leading expertise – and offer a pro\-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. Join us and you could be a part of a team who built a state\-of\-the\-art faculty of medical sciences for a university campus, Eton College Sports and Aquatic Centre, The All England Lawn Tennis Club (AELTC’s) Somerset Road project or King's College School, Wimbledon \- new music school.
The Role You'll Play:

In this graduate role, you’ll join our Structural Engineering team to work on the design of some of the most exciting construction design projects in the UK and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi\-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors.  

Join us as a Graduate Structural Engineer and you’ll work with and be guided by a team of expert engineers to carry out conceptual as well as detailed structural engineering design and analysis, using your maths, science, and problem\-solving skills to design inspirational and sustainable structures and more.  

This role will require you to use your knowledge and expertise to define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, infrastructure, facilities, and services with sustainability at the forefront of the design.  

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and with accredited professional development programmes from the IStructE or ICE, you’ll be supported towards Chartership.
The Skills You'll Bring:
* On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
* Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering.
* You’ll have a keen interest in structural design and analysis for the built environment, and crucially \- have a passion for creative and intuitive design.
* Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB).
* You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
* Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can\-do attitude.

**What’s in it for you?**

  

We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.

  

Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

* A one\-off joining bonus of £1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
* A £2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
* 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
* A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.


Graduate Brochure

  

Job Description

 *Must have right to work in the UK, we do not provide sponsorship for this role.*

 **We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

new_jobs.description:
Join Our Team:
**PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**

  

Cundall’s Geotechnical Engineering team pride themselves on their exemplary track record of providing innovative and sustainable geotechnical engineering solutions, focused on ensuring the best possible foundations for construction design that improves and protects the environment in which we live.  

The Geotechnical Engineering team are an award\-winning source of world leading expertise, bringing together their technical knowledge in the disciplines of environmental science, environmental engineering, engineering geology, foundation engineering and geotechnics.  

  

The team now looks for an enthusiastic graduate to join them and be a part of future projects – some of the award\-winning projects they’ve already completed include a challenging regional sport and leisure facility, a BMX track, and Lee Valley White Water Centre.

Offering a pro\-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence, becoming a Graduate Geotechnical Engineer at Cundall will see you work on the design of some of the most exciting construction projects in the UK and worldwide.  

Working closely with colleagues across our multi\-disciplinary practice (in particular, our Civil and Structural Engineering teams), you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across all sectors including Education, Healthcare, Critical Systems, Industrial, Residential and Retail.  

As a Geotechnical Engineer, you’ll carry out detailed geotechnical calculations and analysis, prepare site investigations and risk assessments, and formulate geotechnical designs (shallow strips/pads, piled foundations, slope stability, retaining structures), specification and procurement.  

Assuming greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, you’ll also be well supported towards Chartership.

On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.

Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB).

  

You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.

new_jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29180
Category: Graduates \- Engineering
Job Type: Full\-time
**Engineering \& Quantity Surveying Graduate Development Programme 2027**
=========================================================================


Are you ready to apply your engineering or quantity surveying skills to one of the most ambitious and impactful infrastructure transformations in Ireland?


Do you have, or are you about to get, a degree in Electrical/Telecoms, Civil/ Structural, Mechanical / Energy Engineering or as a Quantity Surveyor?


If so, the ESB Technical Graduate Programme is your opportunity to work at the forefront of Ireland’s clean energy transition, designing, building, and maintaining the electricity network that connects homes, businesses, and communities across the country.


With over 1000 engineers, quantity surveyors and related technical professionals, ESB is dedicated to investing in engineering related expertise and developing critical skills to support Ireland’s future growth and development.


ESB’s Technical Graduate Programme is designed for STEM graduates with less than two years’ experience, offering structured development, real responsibility, and the opportunity to contribute to our Net Zero by 2040 strategy. At ESB, we believe our people are the driving force behind everything we do \- today and into the future. That’s why investing in your growth, development and potential isn’t just part of our strategy, it’s at the very heart of it.

  

**The programme has a wide variety of opportunities:**

  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, quantity surveyors and technical professionals on projects that matter.

  

**What You’ll Work On:**

  

* Delivering energy infrastructure projects for Ireland, with opportunities to be involved at every stage of the project lifecycle
* Designing, planning and building the electricity network of the future
* Helping to shape ESB's generation fleet on site, ensuring the safety, reliability and resilience of our thermal and renewable energy facilities
* Supporting Ireland's largest private telecoms network, helping keep ESB's infrastructure connected and operating safely
* Supporting ESB’s customers to optimise their energy use \& develop sustainable energy solutions
  

**Our bespoke Early Career Technical Talent Programme includes:**

  

* Structured, timely learning and development through formal as well as on\-the\-job opportunities
* Work assignments giving appropriate breath of learning to facilitate career progression
* Performance targets set to challenge \& develop you while you contribute to ESB’s strategy
* Mentoring \& career support to enable you to find the right career in the company
* Social networking to develop peer supports \& relationships across ESB
  

In addition:

  

As an employee on our Technical Graduate Programme, you will enjoy our many benefits including a competitive salary and bonus, performance related promotions and a comprehensive benefits package built on the four pillars of reward, career, community, and wellbeing.

  

**Location**

  

Nationwide

  

**What We Look For:**

  

* A Masters, Honours or Ordinary degree (or near completion in 2027\) in Electrical/Telecoms, Civil/Structural, Mechanical/Energy Engineering or Quantity Surveying, with aminimum Second Class Honours Grade 1 (2\.1\) result
* Excellent analytical skills combined with the ability to learn quickly
* Proven ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced team environment
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Flexibility regarding work location (for your development you may need to change work location during the programme)
  

**Your CV should be no longer than 2 pages and clearly outline the following:**


* Details of ALL your qualifications including titles, institutions, years of commencement and (projected) completion with your results to date
* Your relevant modules and academic projects
* All your work experience
* Any relevant external interests / pursuits
* A contact telephone number (with voicemail enabled)
* A valid email address to reach you on
**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**


ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.


**About ESB**


Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero\-carbon electricity.

At ESB, technology plays a leading role in enabling and realising our purpose to deliver a brighter future for the customers and communities we serve. Today that means we are driven to make a difference – net zero by 2040 – and it’s our people who ensure we succeed.


With almost 500 people working across our IT Delivery and CIO functions, together we design, build and support a broad range of technologies and services to deliver on our strategic objectives – decarbonised electricity, resilient infrastructure and empowered customers.


To further enhance our capabilities and to transform ESB to a data driven and digital utility, we are looking for Graduates to join our highly motivated and skilled team of IT professionals where you will have the opportunity to deliver results in a fast\-paced, innovative team environment.

  

Our IT Graduate Development Programme is structured into five distinct career paths where you will be able to grow your experience, as well as develop the necessary skills to help you on your way to career success.


As part of the Software graduate programme, you will work within multidisciplinary product teams alongside developers, designers, data engineers, architects, analysts and business stakeholders to deliver innovative, secure and customer\-centred digital and data solutions. Our teams combine technology, design and business expertise to solve complex challenges and create value for customers, colleagues and the wider organisation.


Our graduate programme provides graduates with the opportunity to build capabilities across the full product and software delivery lifecycle. You will gain hands\-on experience in the discovery, design, development, testing, deployment and support of digital and data products and services, working with a wide range of technologies, platforms and delivery approaches.


You will develop the technical, analytical, problem\-solving and collaborative skills required to succeed in a modern digital organisation while contributing to projects that support ESB's transition to a net zero future.

  

**Graduates will be developed in suitable career paths including:**


* Software Engineer
* Front\-End Developer
* Back\-End Developer
* Front\-End Engineer
* Data Engineer
* Data Analyst
* Design Engineer
* UX Designer
* UI Designer
* Experience Designer
* Product Designer
**What to expect**


Our bespoke IT Graduate Development Programme includes:

  

* Structured Rotations – Our graduate programme is typically structured into rotations aligned with career paths and capability development where you will build your IT and business knowledge through challenging assignments, a diverse range of business activities, and the potential to work on projects.
* Learning \& Development – Central to our programme is your learning and development. Structured leadership development, training opportunities, innovation programmes, on\-the\-job learning and work\-shadowing are complemented with personal development programmes and supports designed to help you grow professionally and personally.
* Performance Orientated – At the start of each of your rotations, you will agree with your Line Manager the goals of the assignment and put in place the steps to help achieve them. Ongoing one\-to\-one conversations and management reviews will ensure that you are constantly working towards achieving your professional status and position you for a career with ESB.
* Supportive Working Environment – In addition to your immediate support network of Line Manager, Middle Manager, Team Colleagues and Graduate Peers, you will also be assigned a Buddy and a Mentor.
* Social Networking – Over the last few years our Graduates have been involved in all sorts of Sports and Social activities. Anything from Tag Rugby, Cricket, Soccer and GAA, to language classes, team building challenges, charity work and graduate social events. Our clubs, societies and networks are a great way to build your contacts and of course make new connections.
  
**Why work with us?**

We offer a competitive graduate salary and a comprehensive benefits package built on four pillars of Reward, Career, Community, and Well\-being:


* Progressive, hybrid working model
* Career development through mentoring and training
* Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities
* Sports and Social Clubs
* Credit Union access
* Pension Scheme
* Employee well\-being programmes
* Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
* Great team environment with our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Trusted, and Driven
**Location**


This position will be based in **ESB Head Office, F27, 2 Fitzwilliam Street, Dublin 4\.**

Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in\-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.  



**What We Look For?**


* You should have (or be working towards) a minimum 2\.1 Honours Degree in IT, Computer Sciences, Business Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Finance or an equivalent course where IT was a component
* At least 6 months work experience related to the stream you are applying to
* Proven ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced team environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent analytical skills, combined with the ability to learn quickly.
  

Your CV should be no longer than 2 pages and clearly outline the following:


* Title of your Degree, and Masters (if applicable)
* Your results to date
* Your final year subjects
* The title of your Final Year project
* Any relevant work experience
* A contact telephone number (please ensure a voicemail function is activated on your phone)
  
**Closing Date: 19th October 2026**


**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**


ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.


**About ESB**


Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero\-carbon electricity.

new_jobs.description:
Join Our Team:
**PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**  

With 29 locations, Cundall’s global presence allows our structural engineers to be involved in many challenging and exciting building projects.

  

Working across a variety of industry sectors, our Structures teams are renowned for producing innovative and award\-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. To build on our great work so far, we are looking for graduates who want to create, improve and protect the environment in which we live and provide the facilities for day\-to\-day life, transport and industry to function effectively.  

The Structural engineering teams provide industry\-leading expertise – and offer a pro\-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. Join us and you could be a part of a team who built a state\-of\-the\-art faculty of medical sciences for a university campus, Eton College Sports and Aquatic Centre, The All England Lawn Tennis Club (AELTC’s) Somerset Road project or King's College School, Wimbledon \- new music school.
The Role You'll Play:

In this graduate role, you’ll join our Structural Engineering team to work on the design of some of the most exciting construction design projects in Ireland and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi\-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors.  

Join us as a Graduate Structural Engineer and you’ll work with and be guided by a team of expert engineers to carry out conceptual as well as detailed structural engineering design and analysis, using your maths, science, and problem\-solving skills to design inspirational and sustainable structures and more.  

This role will require you to use your knowledge and expertise to define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, infrastructure, facilities, and services with sustainability at the forefront of the design.  

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and with accredited professional development programmes from the IStructE or ICE, you’ll be supported towards Chartership.
The Skills You'll Bring:
* On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
* Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering.
* You’ll have a keen interest in structural design and analysis for the built environment, and crucially \- have a passion for creative and intuitive design.
* Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB).
* You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
* Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can\-do attitude.

**What’s in it for you?**

  

We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.

  

Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

* A one\-off joining bonus of €1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
* A €2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
* 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
* A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.

Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

new_jobs.title: Sales Engineer, Modernization
new_jobs.description:
KONE moves two billion people every day. As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, we employ over 60,000 driven professionals in more than 60 countries worldwide joined together by a shared purpose, to shape the future of cities. In 2024, we had annual net sales of EUR 11\.1 billion.  



  

KONE has consistently been featured on Forbes list of World's Best Innovative Companies, World's Best Employers \& World's Largest Public Companies. At KONE, we believe in teamwork and a work culture where everyone can be who they are. This is exactly what makes us strong and successful.  



  

**Why this role?**

  

The Sales Engineer Modernization works with new KONE customers, proactively targeting modernization opportunities outside the current customer base. He/she sells all modernizations, full replacements, Advanced People Flow Solutions and other digital solutions.  



  

**What will you be doing?**

  

Customer relationship management  



  

* Proactively develops and creates customer relationships in his/her area of responsibility
* Is accountable for developing KONE position in his/her customer base or market area
* Creates and communicates leads and sales opportunities for entire KONE sales team (e.g. cross\-selling)
* Ensures customer satisfaction and solves complaints with the rest of KONE team
Documents the customer and contact information, maintains customer data  
* 

  

  

Sell  



  

* Proactively generates opportunities from outside current customer base
* Handles RFQs
* Is accountable for leads, opportunities, orders and contracts to meet the sales budget and pricing targets
* Is accountable for finding customer needs and that KONE’s solution matches with the needs
* Is responsible for pricing using the approved tendering tools, and for optimizing prices and discounts within his/her authority
* Validates that the contents of the contract are in line with the negotiation process outcome
* Maintains full information of opportunities, tasks and visits (sales funnel management)
* Responsible for timely and accurate reporting in CRM
* Responsible for gathering relevant information about market and competitors from the field
* Supports the finance function in money collection.
Drives execution of her/his individual sales plan  
* 

  

  

**Are you the one?**

  

* Sales and/ or customer service experience.
* Experience from/ familiar with solution selling methodology
* Experience from/ familiar with (selling) complex technology solutions
* Masters the sales process
* Numbers and facts drive actions
* Is able to bring across customer needs, add value to customers’ businesses by offering solutions that meet their needs and is able to use value based pricing to guarantee healthy margins
* Comfortable and excited about the opportunities that digital solutions bring.
Accustomed to use different sales tools  
* 

  

  

**What’s On Offer**

  

* Career progression in opportunities within a global organization
* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work
* Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills
You are surrounded by fun colleagues and a lively working environment. The best part is all leaders are great and open\-minded  
* 

  

**To Be Considered**  

  

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our Talent and Culture team will review your application and will be in contact with additional information accordingly.
  

  

In the meantime, feel free to browse our website for additional information on our company, brands and culture – KONE Corporation.

Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized.
